title: sunaptea disticha

It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
